reference_review.redistribution: Repository-authored MIT OR Apache-2.0 generator and deterministic inputs. Python standard library only, in an isolated locked script environment, outside the product and ordinary CI; no upstream source is stored.
reference_review.limitations: The outcome is noiseless and the effect constant, so the ATE is the coefficient by construction; the treatment draws are not reproduced and the doubly-robust properties the fixture names (correct propensity, misspecified outcome nuisance) are not derived. The 0.25 tolerance is a declared band. No uncertainty or calibration claim.
